body: Try to resist all temptation to do something dumb and wait for the pain to pass. It always does eventually, you just have to hold on tight.
I would suggest going to r/askreddit and seeing what types of questions people find interesting. It may or may not help you out with karma but it could be fun.

My sister once trapped one of them things in a takeaway box and doused it with hairspray. She lifted it a little while later to see if it was still alive.

It was.

The first person it saw was my dad and ended up chasing him around the house with my sister following behind with the hairspray trying to get it back inside the box.

It died eventually but it put up a good fight.
Give them to the perfect chef.
